tool.title: A package's exports are its declared, shipped code directories
tool.description: Derive a package's `package.json` `exports` from the instance declaration beside it: a directory declared with graph typology `code` (top level or from within) AND named in `files` is exported as `./<dir>/*.js → ./<dir>/*.ts` and `./<dir>/* → ./<dir>/*`; a declared code directory that is not shipped (`test/`) stays private. Keys without `*` are named entry points, kept as written and checked to point into an exported directory. Without `--write` it reports each difference; with it, it rewrites `exports`. Exit 0 in agreement, 1 drift, 2 cannot tell (no declaration, no `package.json`, or no shipped code directory).

inputs.name: root
inputs.description: The instance whose package to check. Default: the instance holding the script.

outputs.name: findings
outputs.description: Each difference between the written and the derived `exports`, or the directories exported and those declared but not shipped.

$comment.comment:
Owner, 2026-10-14 (bean 7pvn, mo75 exports item, option 1): a layer is
imported by package name, and what it exports is what it DECLARES as
code, not a hand list. A layer that cannot be imported by name is reached
by `../../` paths that only work when every layer sits at one sibling path.
